notes.title: V0.8.1.1 - Jul 21, 2024 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Purchasing house upgrades now takes ¢
Fixed bug where items could be crafted and wasted if inventory was full
Fixed bug where Katie would be frozen if leaving the Forest with a menu open
Fixed bug with the Floor display in Forest
Fixed bug where clicking to close dialogue screen when manually Rebirthing could cause a crash
